response.original_title: Leben und Thaten des berühmten Ritters Schnapphahnski
response.overview: Georg Weerth comments on the adventurous life of a Prussian-Silesian Junker. With a great fondness for women, he throws himself from one romantic adventure into the next, fails, becomes a slanderer and forger, tries his luck as a mercenary, and finally finds himself ruined, clinging to the remnants of his estate, when he discovers a fabulously wealthy old duchess. His romantic services earn him money and a new standing in society.
response.title: Life and Actions of the Famous Knight Schnapphahnski
